Rule: "If a campus event serves refreshments after 8 PM, a certified sanitation permit is mandatory. No event without an approved permit may open its doors." An event opened at 9 PM without a permit. What valid deduction must follow?

administeredQuestions.question_text: An online education portal experiences sudden traffic spikes during exams. The engineering lead suggests migrating from a monolithic server to a microservices cloud container architecture. What is the fundamental technical reasoning behind this choice?

administeredQuestions.question_text: An engineer notes that an internal combustion engine converts 30% of fuel energy into mechanical motion, while 70% is dissipated as heat. To improve thermodynamic efficiency, which engineering principle applies?
discriminator_tags: Thermodynamic Heat Recovery vs Superficial Visual Styling

administeredQuestions.question_text: A bacterial colony treated with antibiotic X initially shows 99% mortality, but after 10 generations, the survival rate rises to 80% under the same dosage. What is the fundamental biological explanation?

administeredQuestions.question_text: An automated search routine scans an unsorted list of 1,000,000 user IDs. Method A checks each item one-by-one from start to finish. Method B first sorts the list, then uses binary divide-and-conquer search for all future lookups. Why is Method B systematically superior for repeated queries?
discriminator_tags: Logarithmic Algorithmic Efficiency vs Visual Styling

administeredQuestions.question_text: In an A/B usability test for an e-commerce checkout page, Design Version A had a 2% purchase completion rate, while Design Version B with simplified 1-click payment and transparent order breakdown achieved a 6% completion rate. What is the evidence-based takeaway?

administeredQuestions.question_text: Your student project web application slows down drastically whenever more than 100 users search the database simultaneously. Server logs show the database CPU hits 100% while processing repeated full-table text scans. What is the most effective immediate architectural remedy?

Investigation reveals the training dataset included "Capstone Grade Final Score" as an input feature. What methodology flaw occurred?

Thermographic inspection shows excessive heat conduction through uninsulated copper mounting brackets attached directly to the metal exterior frame. What is the direct engineering remedy?

Home visits reveal families store filtered water in wide-mouth unwashed clay pots, scooping water with contaminated communal cups. How should the intervention be adapted?

Wastewater enters with a dye concentration of 200 mg/L at a steady flow rate of 50 L/hour. After how many operating hours will the carbon bed reach saturation breakthrough?
